svg.text: L47 repair-after-stop: the re-entrain restart is NOT a repair
h40 cord, stop 20 s DNg88 −8, repair = 20 s re-entrain 0.7 Hz; S per side, rolling 5 s; duty(both≥.25) late = 0.000 everywhere
A. no repair: census state SL+|SR− holds all 120 s
B. immediate repair: drive holds S_R — release re-lotteries
during: S_R +.68..+.78; after: hop (s11/33) or census (s22)
● S_L ▢ S_R — paired per seed; none reach both≥.25
